sources.observation: RLIMIT_AS bounds process virtual address space. Soft limits cannot exceed hard limits; an unprivileged process cannot raise a hard limit.
Git documents mapping windows and simultaneous mapped pack limits. A pack file can be mapped in regions, so total pack size alone does not prove a failed mapping size or establish root cause.

source_review_implication: Inspect actual error and exact delta; do not assert every pack larger than RLIMIT_AS must fail.
